parameters.separation: 5.5 / 4.3 m in every cadence (plan hypotheses, no source)
parameters.nan_rule: first local max with r[k] > 0 after the first r[k] < 0; NaN if none or if r[k] / r[0] <= band_z / sqrt(n - k) (reading A)
parameters.noise: per ankle and frame, sd = its p90_mae_cm in a skeleton of the clip under the cap drawn per frame; along d N(0, mae), in z kz x as large; AR(1) along the frames with coefficient rho
parameters.rel_err: |cad_s - planted| / planted over the windows with a finite cad_s

bar.rule: a (W, cap) cell passes when every cadence meets the bar at rho 0; at rho 0.5 to 0.9 meets_bar is printed and judged by no rule

h_rows.note: informative, read by no rule: sane, the broken rows no_gait (i) and flat_h (ii), the blind spots swap and lean; abs_diff over the windows with both cadences finite; rel_err_h against the planted cadence
